title: Three Paths Converge as One
next_chapter_hook: The moment Cang Yutian's voice fell, a golden rift tore open in the depths of the heavens—that was the Heavenly Eye itself gazing upon this place, as if this most audacious chess game in ten thousand years had finally stirred the board itself.

text.content: The Heavenly Eye's gaze pressed upon his shoulders like tangible weight, yet Chen Ji smiled. That smile held no fear, no reverence—only a kind of maddened liberation. When a person decides to no longer be a piece on the board, what could be more exhilarating than facing the chess player himself? 'You see me.' He murmured to the giant eye in the void, 'So what? Today I shall let you know that this chessboard holds more than just the pieces you have placed.'

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's form materialized at Chen Ji's side, her demonic miasma churning like tides, yet hissing where it touched the golden gaze. 'Chen Ji, you've lost your mind.' Her voice carried a rare tremor, 'The Heavenly Eye gazing upon you personally—do you understand what that signifies?'

text.content: 'It means it's finally taking me seriously.' Chen Ji turned to Ye Qing, his gaze carrying a light she had never seen before. It wasn't the ethereal azure glow of the Tianji Record fragments, but something more fierce, more domineering—as if some power was awakening within him. The shards of three paths in his Mental Sea quivered simultaneously, yearning for the first time to resonate together.

dialogue.content: The golden eye in the void slightly contracted, and an ancient, majestic voice thundered across heaven and earth: 'Interesting. For ten thousand years, finally a mere ant dares to look directly at me.' No emotion could be detected in that voice, yet all spiritual energy within a million li instantly froze solid. Cang Yutian—the incarnation of the Heavenly Eye, the ultimate chess master—had finally shifted his gaze from behind the scenes to the spotlight.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a searing pain in his Mental Sea. The Tianji Record fragments convulsed violently, the power of fate writing galloping like an untamed horse, the three path fragments colliding, intertwining, fusing in an unprecedented way. He knew he was taking a risk, yet his eyes reflected only exhilaration—the core of his '爽快' personality was never about restraint, but about striking when the moment was right, slapping back with force.

dialogue.content: 'What are you attempting?' Cang Yutian's voice finally carried a hint of fluctuation. Chen Ji drew a deep breath, his hands forming seals with sudden force. In that instant, the three fragments in his Mental Sea collided with a thunderous roar, merging into a singular point of blinding radiance. The light carried the predictive power of the Tianji Record, the treacherous transformations of the demonic path, and his own profound understanding of destiny—for the first time, the power of three paths briefly coexisted within a single individual.

text.content: 'Three Paths Converge as One.' Chen Ji's voice reverberated through heaven and earth, carrying a near-blasphemous arrogance, 'This is what your 'ant' can accomplish. You have orchestrated for ten thousand years, manipulated countless pieces—did you ever imagine that one day, a piece would bite back?' His aura surged to quasi-celestial level in that moment, causing the entire Tianqing Sect ruins to tremble beneath his might.

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's phantom solidified in the golden light, transforming into an imposing elder whose face remained obscured. His gaze no longer carried indifference, but held something resembling... appreciation? 'Ten thousand years.' He strode toward Chen Ji, each step causing space to shudder, 'You are the first ant to make me feel threatened.'

text.content: Ye Qing instinctively moved to shield Chen Ji, her demonic miasma weaving into a barrier. But Cang Yutian merely raised a finger and tapped lightly—the barrier shattered like thin ice. His gaze bypassed Ye Qing, fixing directly on Chen Ji: 'You are worthy of knowing the truth. The Tianji Record was one of the pieces I placed in this world, but it chose you—this proves you hold more value than my predetermined game.'

dialogue.content: Chen Ji wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth; the backlash from Three Paths Converging was eroding his foundation, yet his smile only widened. 'So what?' He met Cang Yutian's gaze, words precise and deliberate, 'You wish to recruit me? To make me, like those prophetic seers throughout the ages, become merely another piece on your chessboard?'

text.content: 'No.' Cang Yutian's answer was unexpected, 'I wish to make you my successor, not a piece. For ten thousand years I have manipulated destiny, yet no one could stand beside me. You—the first variable.' He extended his hand, a golden mark materializing in his palm, 'Accept it, and you shall possess power equal to mine. Refuse...'

'What happens if I refuse?' Chen Ji interrupted, his voice thick with mockery, 'You think I would believe such words? How many geniuses have fallen to these very promises over ten thousand years—ending up as dry bones upon your chessboard? I, Chen Ji, would rather die standing than live on my knees!' His words were resolute, yet at the final moment he hesitated—because he glimpsed in Cang Yutian's eyes a fleeting flash of... approval?

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's words echoed in his ears; the proposal was too enticing—quasi-celestial level power, sufficient to overturn all patterns. But the pride within Chen Ji's bones screamed furiously: never be anyone's piece! This moment, he had to make a choice.

choices.description: Chen Ji sneered: 'Successor? Such pretty words, yet merely another puppet to be controlled. How many geniuses have fallen to this very promise over ten thousand years—I, Chen Ji, refuse to be the next!'
choices.visible_cost: Losing the Opportunity of a Heavenly Dao-level Backer
choices.visible_reward: Maintaining Independent Will, Earning Cang Yutian's Genuine Respect
choices.risk_hint: Complete Severance from the Heavenly Eye, Future Confrontation with unimaginable Pursuit

text.content: Cang Yutian's eyes gleamed with even deeper appreciation. He withdrew the golden mark, yet showed no anger—instead speaking softly: 'Good. You have backbone. For ten thousand years, finally someone dares say 'no' to me.' His phantom began to dissipate, yet before vanishing completely, he left words that chilled Chen Ji's heart—'Since you have chosen to oppose me, let me see how far this variable of yours can go. Remember, a true storm is about to arrive—you had better... survive until that day.'

choices.description: A sharp light flashed in Chen Ji's eyes—opposing the Heavenly Eye directly was foolish; better to play along while secretly gathering strength. He clasped his hands in salute: 'I am honored by the senior's esteemed regard. Grant me three days to consider.'
choices.visible_cost: Need to Scheme with a Tiger, Risking Being Seen Through
choices.visible_reward: Buying Buffer Time, Potentially Gaining More Heavenly Secrets
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian is an ancient chess master, likely to have his disguise exposed
choices.process_label: 陈机表面恭敬地请求考虑

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian looked at Chen Ji, a meaningful glint flickering in his eyes. "Consider?" He laughed lightly, that laughter making Chen Ji's back instantly soaked with cold sweat. "A proposal from a ten-thousand-year chess master, do you think there's room for 'consideration'?" He reached out again, the golden mark flying directly toward Chen Ji's brow center. "But I like smart people. Three days is too little, I'll give you thirty breaths. After thirty breaths, either accept, or—never have to consider again."

choices.description: Chen Ji didn't answer immediately, but stared directly at Cang Yutian: "You said the Tianji Record is one of the chess pieces you laid out—then what are the other pieces? What is this 'real storm' you speak of? Give me a reason not to kill you."
choices.visible_reward: Obtain key plot information, providing basis for subsequent arrangements
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heavenly Secrets' response may exceed imagination, bringing greater psychological impact
choices.process_label: 陈机冷静地提出交换条件

text.content: Cang Yutian fell silent for three breaths, and within those eyes that could not see through reality, something like... nostalgia seemed to flash. "The other pieces..." he spoke slowly, "Generations of prophets, ancient secret realms, sealed evil artifacts... Do you think the opportunities in this world come from nowhere? They are all bait I scattered. As for the real storm..." His voice suddenly turned grave, "The day the Tianji Record becomes complete marks the time of heavenly reincarnation. At that time, not just me, but this entire heaven and earth will be reshaped. If you accept my mark, you will have a place in the new world; if you don't accept... you will only turn to ash in the calamity."

Chen Ji felt violent tremors in his Mental Sea. Cang Yutian's words were like a basin of ice water poured over his head—heavenly reincarnation? The day the Tianji Record becomes complete? What did this mean? It meant that the power he had been pursuing all along actually led to a world-destroying catastrophe? And he himself was the key to trigger this catastrophe?

dialogue.content: Ye Qing seemed to sense Chen Ji's abnormality. She abruptly stepped forward, shielding him, her voice pressed extremely low: "Chen Ji, don't listen to him! The Eye of Heavenly Secrets is best at weaving lies with truths—if you believe, you'll fall right into his trap!" Her Demonic Path mist churned around her, yet it retreated step by step under this Heavenly pressure.

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcefully suppressing the turmoil in his Mental Sea. He looked at Cang Yutian and suddenly smiled—that was a kind of relief after seeing through everything. "So... the successor you've been searching for ten thousand years, not because of admiration, but because of fear?" His voice gradually rose, "Heavenly reincarnation requires someone to bear the karma, and you don't want to bear it yourself, so you're dragging me into your mess? Cang Yutian, you are even more... pitiful than I imagined."

dialogue.content: Cang Yutian's shadow stiffened almost imperceptibly. It was an extremely subtle change, so subtle that unless Chen Ji had been observing intently, it would have been impossible to notice. But this momentary stiffness gave Chen Ji his answer—he had won the gamble. The Eye of Heavenly Secrets was not omniscient; it too had weaknesses, had fears. And his words had precisely struck the soft spot this ten-thousand-year-old existence least wanted others to see through.

text.content: "Pitiful?" Cang Yutian's voice suddenly cooled, the surrounding golden light began to turn blinding. "You think a mere ant who hasn't even stepped through the Heavenly threshold has the qualification to judge me?" He stepped forward, the pressure doubling abruptly. Ye Qing groaned, blood seeping from the corner of her mouth.

A flash of fury appeared in Chen Ji's eyes. What he hated most was anyone hurting those who belonged to him. Ye Qing was his ally on the Demonic Path, one of the few people who genuinely helped him—and Cang Yutian dared to hurt her right before his eyes? In this moment, the "extreme protectiveness" within his heroic persona completely erupted.

dialogue.content: "You touched her?" Chen Ji's voice abruptly turned ice-cold, as the power of three pathways surged within him again. Ignoring the intense pain from his Mental Sea, he forcibly compressed and fused the three fragments once more, an unprecedented power erupting from his body and forcibly repelling Cang Yutian's pressure. "Cang Yutian, remember this—from today forward, between us, it's life or death!"

text.content: That brilliant light piercing the heavens tore apart the sky, shattering the Heavenly Secrets within a radius of ten thousand miles. Cang Yutian's shadow actually retreated a step within that light—this was the first time in ten thousand years he was forced back by an ant. Ye Qing watched this scene in disbelief, tears blurring her vision—she had never imagined that this man who had always presented himself as trash could unleash such world-shaking power before the Eye of Heavenly Secrets.

"Good." Cang Yutian's voice rang out again, and this time, within the majesty was a hint of... complex meaning. He made no further move, only quietly watching Chen Ji, as if observing an unexpected treasure. "A fine declaration of life or death. After ten thousand years, I've finally encountered someone who dares to say such words." His shadow began to slowly dissipate. "Since you insist on walking your own path, I'll grant you your wish—not as an heir, but as... an enemy."

dialogue.content: Before Cang Yutian's shadow completely vanished, his voice echoed one final time across heaven and earth: "Remember, the true storm is about to arrive.届时，不只是我，连这方天地的规则都会彻底改变。You want to live, then grow stronger with all your might; if you want to die, I won't mind personally sending you on your way." As the words fell, the golden gaze also vanished, leaving only Chen Ji and Ye Qing, along with the devastated battlefield.

text.content: Chen Ji felt a wave of emptiness within his body. The backlash from the unification of three pathways finally erupted completely. His aura plummeted visibly, falling from quasi-Heavenly level all the way back to Foundation Building. He knelt on one knee, blood seeping from his seven orifices, yet he was still laughing—that was a畅快淋漓的笑, a release after breaking free from chains. "Worth it." he murmured, "So worth it."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing stumbled forward to support him, her voice carrying a sob: "You madman! What couldn't you have used that quasi-Heavenly power for? You actually used it to clash with the Eye of Heavenly Secrets? Do you have any idea you almost died just now?!" She cursed while crying, her Demonic Path mist instinctively wrapping around Chen Ji, helping stabilize his chaotic energy.

text.content: He did it to protect me..." Ye Qing's voice choked. She remembered Chen Ji's words just now, remembered how he erupted before her. In that moment, he was no longer the calculating chess player, but a madman willing to defy heaven to protect those he cared about. Her heart, for the first time, truly moved.
